requirement_or_question: gear-norm-v1 is frozen: 256-entry u64 Gear table table[i]=splitmix64(0x6a09e667f3bcc909+i); from each chunk start hash=(hash<<1)+table[byte] mod 2^64; no cut before minimum; cut when low b+1 bits zero below target and low b-1 bits zero from target (b=log2 target); forced cut at maximum; short tail allowed.

requirement_or_question: Boundary masks test contiguous low-order bits of a shift-left Gear hash, where bit k depends only on the last k+1 bytes, so the effective boundary window is about 20 bytes at a 512 KiB target (no FastCDC spread mask). Short-period or low-entropy content may never cut, and boundary quality is unmeasured.
supersession_note: Code-level fact confirmed by spot-check; docs/chunking-v1.md L39-40 claims normalization benefits without measurement.
